title: 第1741章 中端战场第1740章 摧枯拉朽
content_zh:
“退，快退！”
“魔鬼，这他妈的哪里冒出来的魔鬼，太可怕了！”
夹杂着无尽恐惧的凄惨叫声，在这片战场之上嘹亮的响彻。
在死亡风暴席卷之下，那些存活着的魔族强者当下是吓得亡魂皆冒，没有丝毫犹豫，立即向着远方逃去，眨眼间就消失的无影无踪。
“痛快，太痛快了！”
战车上，陈宗他们身体颤抖，那压抑着疯狂的声音，颤抖的响起。
这是一种兴奋，一种难以置信的颤抖，每一个人都是情绪激动，神情亢奋。
“这是我们吗？！”
仅仅只是大藏境二重的章凡和白子峰二人，更是难以置信的嘶吼着。
那些攻击玉龙战车的，每一个都是魔族阵营中的最强之人，可他们两个杀的，也不比别人少啊。
“小魔头！”
铺天盖地的叫喊声，在此时响彻了天地，几乎所有人都是睁大着眼睛，皆是眼神敬畏的看向肖恩，言语间充满着尊崇之意。
尽管这个少年没有出手，但所有人都知道，能够取得这种战果，无疑是这个少年一手造成的。
可以说是，这种格局的打破，等于救了他们所有人的生命。
现在人魔战场开启才几天的时间，在肖恩他们到来之前，他们都是弱势，伤亡也比魔族大得多。
按照这种趋势，人魔战场结束之后，他们当中，真的没有几个能够保证自己活下来。
“嗯，现在这里，对你们已经构不成威胁了吧？”
肖恩点了点头，然后目光缓缓的扫过诸多人族强者身上，道。
“肯定不会了！”
一名人族强者答道。

现在这片战场的魔族强者已经被消灭了将近半数，而且还是实力最强的，这都能构成威胁，那么，他们也用不着活了。
“你们还要离开吗？”
也有一名人族强者听出肖恩话中之意，满是崇拜的道。
“当然，这里哪是我们混的地方，我们肯定是要上中端战场去的！”
肖恩微笑，身旁的陈宗，却是将昂然的声音响彻，浑身都是散发着浓浓的疯狂。
“哗，果然！”
所有的人族强者都是神色激动，无比的羡慕。
以现在玉龙战车上的实力，他们虽然不敢说能够主宰中端战场，但确实是具备了闯荡的实力。
“小魔头，我们……”
不少声音传出，那些眼神，都是充斥着火热和崇拜。
显然，他们都希望能够成为战车中的一员，心中的那种渴求，几乎是掩饰不住的显露了出来。
“呵呵，现在战车已经满员，容纳不下人了。”
肖恩望着那一道道炽热的目光，唯有苦笑了一下，道。
“太可惜了！”
那些声音，皆是带着遗憾响起，最后，他们都是只能用一种羡慕的眼神目送着肖恩他们离开。
低端层次的境界，却去闯中端战场，但却偏偏又具有这种实力，想想都令人兴奋和热血沸腾。
“这一次上去，不知道我们的军功牌又会上涨到什么样的程度！”
战车上，众多目光火热的望着自己身上的军功牌，不停的赞叹着。
“还用得着说吗，以我们的境界上到中端战场，军功又是按照境界翻倍计算，最少，也能在中端战场拿个第一吧！”
方云天咧嘴一笑，笑容兴奋。

军功固然诱人，但也得要有实力才行，这一点，在他们的心目中已经毋庸置疑。
当然，这种毋庸置疑并不是来自自己的身上，而是那个谜一样的少年。
所以，车上所有人甚至隐隐的有种荒诞的感觉，这中端战场，还不是这个少年的尽头。
content_en:
"Retreat, retreat quickly!"
"Devil, the devil came out of nowhere, it's so scary!"
The miserable screams mixed with endless fear resounded loudly on this battlefield.
Under the death storm, the surviving strong demons were so frightened that they lost their souls. Without any hesitation, they immediately fled into the distance and disappeared without a trace in the blink of an eye.
"It's so happy, so happy!"
On the chariot, Chen Zong and the others were trembling, and the suppressed and crazy voices trembled.
It was an excitement, an incredible tremor, and everyone was excited and excited.
"Is this us?!"
Zhang Fan and Bai Zifeng, who were only at the second level of the Great Tibet Realm, roared in disbelief.
Those who attacked the Jade Dragon Chariot were each the strongest people in the demon camp, but the two of them killed no less than the others.
"Little devil!"
The overwhelming shouts resounded throughout the world at this time. Almost everyone opened their eyes wide and looked at Sean with awe, and their words were full of respect.
Although this young man did not take any action, everyone knew that such a result was undoubtedly caused by this young man.
It can be said that the breaking of this pattern is equivalent to saving all their lives.
It has only been a few days since the human-demonic battlefield was opened. Before Sean and the others arrived, they were all weak and suffered much greater casualties than the demons.
According to this trend, after the battlefield between humans and demons is over, few of them can guarantee their survival.
"Well, now there is no threat to you here, right?"
Sean nodded, then slowly glanced at the many powerful human beings and said.
"Definitely not!"
A human strongman replied.
Now that nearly half of the powerful demons in this battlefield have been wiped out, and they are still the strongest. This can pose a threat, so they don't have to live anymore.
"Are you still leaving?"
There was also a strong human being who understood the meaning of Sean's words and spoke with admiration.
"Of course, this is no place for us to hang out. We must go to the mid-range battlefield!"
Sean smiled, but Chen Zong beside him sounded his proud voice, and his whole body exuded a strong sense of madness.
"Wow, sure enough!"
All the powerful human beings looked excited and extremely envious.
With the current strength of the Jade Dragon Chariot, although they dare not say that they can dominate the mid-range battlefield, they do have the strength to conquer.
"Little devil, we..."
Many voices came out, and those eyes were full of passion and admiration.
Obviously, they all hope to become a member of the chariot, and the desire in their hearts is revealed in an almost unconcealable way.
"Haha, the chariot is now full and can't accommodate anyone."
Sean looked at those blazing eyes and could only smile bitterly and said.
"What a shame!"
Those voices all sounded with regret. In the end, they could only watch Sean and the others leave with envious eyes.
It is exciting and exciting to think about being in a low-end realm, but going to the mid-range battlefield, but having such strength.
"If we go up this time, we don't know how high our military merit cards will rise!"
On the chariot, many eyes looked at the military medals on their bodies with eager eyes and kept praising them.
"Do I need to say it? With our level reaching the mid-level battlefield, military merit will be doubled according to the level. At least, we can get first place in the mid-range battlefield!"
Fang Yuntian grinned excitedly.
Military merit is certainly tempting, but it also requires strength. There is no doubt in their minds.
Of course, this undoubtedly does not come from himself, but from that mysterious young man.
So, the carEveryone on the scene even had a vague feeling that this mid-range battlefield was not the end of the road for this young man.
